scope: Actual production save module with isolated failure-injected Web Storage; physical/browser storage certification is separate.

checks.name: Structured maps preserve distinct Unicode, punctuation, and long keys through commit and reload
Prototype-looking keys remain own data without changing object prototypes
Migrations can rename and default prototype-looking keys without losing data
Cancelling load at reading preserves selected slot, values, metadata, storage, and custom state
Cancelling load at validating preserves selected slot, values, metadata, storage, and custom state
Cancelling load at migrating preserves selected slot, values, metadata, storage, and custom state
Successful async load migrates and deserializes exactly once
Async commit serializes once and writes the exact validated custom snapshot
Cancelling commit at serializing preserves state and writes nothing
Cancelling commit at validating preserves state and writes nothing
Cancelling commit at writing preserves state and writes nothing
Primary-write failure reports failure and preserves the last committed data
Existing sanitized slot names and v2 envelope remain compatible
Project switch during async load rejects the stale result without changing new-project state
Project switch during async commit rejects the stale snapshot without writing or changing new-project state
